senses.gloss: वेण veṇa, m. musician (a mixed caste, offspring 🞄of Vaidehaka and Ambaṣṭhī): ā, f. 🞄N. of a river: -taṭa, m. bank of the Veṇā.

वेणि veṇi, f. braid of hair, esp. of the hair 🞄of women worn in a single plait as a sign of 🞄mourning: -kā, f. continuous line, uninterrupted 🞄stream: -vāhin, a. flowing or causing 🞄to flow in an uninterrupted stream.
वेणी veṇī, f. = veṇi: -saṃhāra, m. tying 🞄up of the braid of hair (of Draupadī), T. of 🞄a play (existing in the tenth century A. D.) 🞄by Bhaṭṭa-nārāyaṇa.

वेणु véṇu (or ú), m. reed, cane, bamboo;
 🞄flute, pipe.
